    class _Chunk:
        __slots__ = ("cv", "counter", "flags", "block", "block_len", "nblocks")
        def __init__(self, cv, counter, flags):
            self.cv, self.counter, self.flags = list(cv), counter, flags
            self.block, self.block_len, self.nblocks = bytearray(_BLOCK), 0, 0

            return self.nblocks * _BLOCK + self.block_len
        def update(self, data: bytes) -> None:

                take = min(_BLOCK - self.block_len, len(data))
                self.block[self.block_len:self.block_len + take] = data[:take]
                self.block_len += take
                data = data[take:]

                    self._absorb(self.chunk.output().chaining_value(), total)

                self.chunk.update(data[:take])
                data = data[take:]

            while total_chunks % 2 == 0:
                cv = _parent_out(self.stack.pop(), cv, self.flags).chaining_value()
                total_chunks //= 2

            out = self.chunk.output()

def est_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    """Deterministic, conservative BPE-ish estimate.

    Model: every whitespace-delimited word costs ceil(len/4) tokens (min 1);
    every newline costs 1.  Deliberately pessimistic so the CONT budget is a
    hard bound under this model.
    """
    lines = text.split("\n")
    words = sum(max(1, (len(w) + 3) // 4) for ln in lines for w in ln.split())
    return words + len(lines) - 1

    """Newest-first tail of the ledger under a HARD token budget.

    The header carries the chain tip as root@seq: the next context window
    resumes with Ledger(seed_root=tip_root, seed_seq=tip_seq) and re-anchors
    tamper-evidence across the window boundary.  Records that do not fit are
    dropped from the block (never from the ledger); a COMPACT record upstream
    is the intended carrier for anything older than the tail.
    """
    if budget < 16:
        raise LedgerError("budget too small for CONT framing")
    tip = ledger.tip
    if tip is None:
        raise LedgerError("cannot build CONT from an empty ledger")
    head = _CONT_HEADER.format(root=tip["key"], seq=tip["seq"], budget=budget)
    base = est_tokens(head) + est_tokens(_CONT_FOOTER) + 1
    lines: list[str] = []
    used = base
    for rec in reversed(list(ledger)):
        line = render_record(rec)
        cost = est_tokens(line) + 1
        if used + cost > budget:
            break
        lines.append(line)
        used += cost
    lines.reverse()
    text = "\n".join([head, *lines, _CONT_FOOTER])
    tokens = est_tokens(text)
    if tokens > budget:  # cannot happen; belt-and-braces hard guarantee
        raise LedgerError("internal budget overrun")
    return ContBlock(text, tip["key"], tip["seq"], len(lines), tokens)
